fundamental.text: Raw sugar is 2.03¢/lb above hydrous-ethanol parity in Brazil, so mills favour sugar in the mix (more supply). Sugar in BRL at R$2,298/t (57th pct of 5 yrs). The break below the 18c floor turned into a two-session slide, and Monday's bounce was short covering met by Brazilian mill and grower hedging on a weak real: the real channel is capping rallies while funds still hold a large net long. Desk read: Mar has pushed back above 18c (about 18.1, +2.7% early) on a softer dollar, firmer crude and a steadier real, which reduce the incentive for Brazilian mills to hedge. There is still no new centre-south crush or mix data, so this is a currency and positioning move; the Brazil supply picture has not changed.
